name: Applied Commerce Grade 8–12 source register
authority: Current authored Applied Commerce learner books supplied by the product owner
purpose: Canonical curriculum ancestry for BIS concept, competency, teaching and reporting design.

books.title: Applied Commerce Grade 8
books.portfolioEmphasis: Identity, resources, habits and capstone evidence.

books.title: Applied Commerce Grade 9
books.coreQuestion: What kind of worker, earner, and creator am I becoming?
books.portfolioEmphasis: Enterprise, community money, habit transformation, community project and path-forward evidence.
books.authoredCompetencyMapping: The manuscript contains LO / Business Studies / EMS competency mappings in the mapped lesson sequence. These remain authored source metadata and are not represented as official DBE certification.

books.title: Applied Commerce Grade 10
books.coreQuestion: How do I build systems that last — and what happens when they fail?
books.portfolioEmphasis: Value creation, investing, financial systems and financial independence.

books.title: Applied Commerce Grade 11
books.coreQuestion: How can I achieve more with less — less time, less money, less effort?

books.title: Applied Commerce Grade 12
books.coreQuestion: How do I launch into adulthood with evidence, purpose and protection?
books.portfolioEmphasis: Transition, career launch, risk and protection, and integrated Life Launch.

ingestionContract.lessonIndex: All 395 lesson positions are indexed by grade, term and title.
ingestionContract.competencyMetadata: Only competency codes and meanings explicitly present in the authored source may be stored as source mappings.
ingestionContract.interpretation: BIS may derive an internal curriculum crosswalk from authored concepts, but derived BIS competencies must remain distinct from source-authored or external framework labels.
ingestionContract.externalAlignment: No official CAPS/DBE approval or equivalence is asserted by this register.
ingestionContract.sourceIntegrity: Do not change a source lesson merely to satisfy a BIS runtime or reporting model.
ingestionContract.reporting: A source ancestry link identifies where a concept is taught. It never proves learner competence by itself.
